pages.title: Exotic Matter Singularity
pages.text: Negative mass, massless alloy, antimatter, strange matter, dark matter: every substance that should not exist, compressed together. They ought to annihilate each other or fly apart. Instead they sit in uneasy balance, and the point seems to push and pull at once.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered every form of exotic matter and fed them into the Compressor together, half expecting an explosion. Negative mass cancelled the rest, and they settled into one strangely stable point.
